conversion: rdata.read_rda; no R code executed; original values retained
design: 50 observations in each of four colour-form by sex groups. Mixture weights are sample fractions, not estimates of population prevalence.
label_policy: Colour form and sex are external interpretation variables; never used in density fitting or initialization. Group-stratified bootstrap is a separately declared sampling-design sensitivity.
labels_note: Use colour-form terminology consistently; no new taxonomic claim.
original_study: Campbell and Mahon (1974), Australian Journal of Zoology 22, 417-425
